metadata.description: Sujeet's marketplace exposing the adk plugin (Agent Development Kit) for Claude Code. Two install paths: the default 'adk' entry tracks the latest commit on the main branch on GitHub; the 'adk-npm' entry installs the plugin from the npm registry so you can pin to a semver release. Refresh with `/plugin marketplace update sujeet-pro-adk`.

plugins.name: adk
plugins.description: Agent Development Kit - 50+ composable skills, specialized subagents, hooks, MCP servers, and monitors for the developer loop. Built for Claude Code and Claude Desktop. Tracks the latest commit on the main branch and refreshes on `/plugin marketplace update`.

plugins.name: adk-npm
plugins.description: Same ADK plugin, installed from the npm registry as 'agents-devkit'. Use this when you want to pin to a specific semver release (set version constraints via `/plugin install`) instead of always tracking the main branch.
